recommendation.summary: dsh-tui 0.11.1 is an interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness, mounted as a Cordis bundle patch over dsh-base. Author intent is a single TUI plane: the README documents `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui` and states `dsh-tui` and `dsh --profile dsh-tui` are equivalent, so executionProfiles is [tui] with tuiProfile dsh-tui. No headless, SDK, ACP or Web workflow is documented by the plugin; the web-app peer and verify:web-coexistence only describe coexistence with an official Web profile. Node: engines.node is `^22.19 || >=24` (declared support) and CI configures node-version 24 in every job, so 24 is the preferred CI-tested major and 22 is recorded as declared support; no explicit author recommendation exists. Package manager: packageManager pnpm@11.21.0 (development scope); the README notes pnpm is needed for first-run profile initialization but pins no consumer version. Author DSH baseline: 0.1.7-rc.2 is the primary validated line (README and pnpm-workspace.yaml); this is an author claim, not a Radar result. Development overrides pin the @deepseek-ai tree to 0.1.7-rc.2 locally and must not be copied into a consumer profile. No plugin-documented disabled/offline startup flags were found.

conclusion.statement: dsh-tui 0.11.1 (@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui) was reviewed and exercised on the author's primary validated DSH line 0.1.7-rc.2 and on the Radar host DSH 0.2.0-rc.1, on Node 22 and Node 24, across the native load plane and the plugin's documented TUI plane. On the author baseline 0.1.7-rc.2 the exact artifact installed, registered, loaded, satisfied its direct Node peer contracts, and the TUI plane produced a real PTY frame, accepted input, and completed controlled shutdown on both Node 22 and Node 24 (4 compatible cells). On DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 the native plane failed at the traced plugin install step on both Node 22 and Node 24 (install-failed), and the TUI-plane install did not produce a bounded result on either major: the pnpm install timed out at 180s after resolving 606 packages and adding 538, so profile, registration, host, surface, interaction and shutdown were all skipped and those two cells are unknown, not passing. The 0.2.0-rc.1 install failure is a host-line incompatibility signal, not a Node-major signal: the same artifact and the same Node majors succeeded on 0.1.7-rc.2, and the plugin's published peer ranges top out at the 0.1.7-rc.2 line. No live handles remained at inspect time, so no cancellation was required. Author intent is a single TUI plane (executionProfiles [tui], tuiProfile dsh-tui); no headless, SDK, ACP or Web workflow is documented by the plugin, and none was tested. Node 24 is the CI-configured major and Node 22.19+/24+ is the declared engines range; no author-recommended major exists. Authenticated integrations, terminal graphics, migration, VS Code/Herdr integration and the launcher subcommands were not exercised.
coverageNotes: DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 TUI-plane cells (dsh-tui-node22-tui, dsh-tui-node24-tui) are unknown: the pnpm profile install timed out at 180s, so profile creation, registration, host, surface, interaction and shutdown were skipped and were not verified.

DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 native cells (dsh-tui-node22, dsh-tui-node24) are install-failed at the traced plugin install step; this is a host-line signal, not a Node-major signal, since the same artifact passed on 0.1.7-rc.2 on both majors.
The author DSH baseline 0.1.7-rc.2 is an author claim; the compatible results above are Radar observations on that line and do not establish consumer compatibility.
No headless, SDK, ACP or Web workflow is documented by the plugin, so none was selected or tested; the optional @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app peer and verify:web-coexistence describe coexistence only.
Authenticated integrations were not exercised: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and the /login OAuth providers (ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Pro/Max, SuperGrok) cannot be completed by Radar.
Terminal graphics (Kitty/Sixel), clipboard tools, alt-screen mouse selection and resize behavior need a real interactive terminal and were not covered.
dsh-tui migrate (Claude Code/Codex/OMP/zcode/Grok Build import) was not exercised.
The dsh-tui-vscode extension and the Herdr integration were not exercised.
Launcher subcommands dsh-tui safe/doctor/update and the in-TUI /update self-update path were not exercised.
Windows-specific behavior (danger-full-access default, approval never, win32-input-mode paste handling) was not exercised.

Collection gaps remain: docs/getting-started.en.md, docs/getting-started.md, docs/plugins.md, docs/README.md, docs/configuration.en.md and docs/configuration.md were omitted by the evidence byte budget.
